title: 1956 AHSME Problem 13
statement: Given two positive integers \(x\) and \(y\) with \(x\lt y.\) The percent that \(x\) is less than \(y\) is:

solutions.text:
The difference is \(y-x.\) Measured as a fraction of the reference value \(y,\) this is \(\frac{y-x}{y}.\) Multiplying by \(100\) converts the fraction to a percent: \[ \frac{100(y-x)}y. \]

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: The amount by which \(x\) is smaller is \(y-x\)
Because the comparison is to \(y,\) use \(y\) as the denominator
